residualRisks.summary: All 43 attempted candidates are terminally rejected; none currently has qualifying assistant-quality evidence.
residualRisks.mitigation: Screen new immutable sources before conversion; if no source passes, complete explicit corpus review and run contamination-controlled training only from approved records.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Twenty distinct model lineages have current qualification receipts under the current evaluator.

residualRisks.summary: No qualifying fresh-profile dogfood round can run until qualified model artifacts exist.
residualRisks.mitigation: Admit qualified models, then execute the fixed fifty-round schedule through owned persistent profiles with physical deletion receipts.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Exactly fifty current clean-browser receipts pass and every scheduled model executes at least twice.

residualRisks.summary: The required MemoryEndpoints single-use enrollment, reconnect, replay, revocation, and cleanup contract is not advertised for authorized production use.
residualRisks.mitigation: Obtain and validate the versioned platform contract, then execute twenty-five isolated company creation, restore, replay-rejection, close, delete, and post-delete runs.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Twenty-five current live-service receipts prove continuity and cleanup without invoking an undocumented route.

residualRisks.summary: Local two-process serving evidence does not establish public reachability or a complete outside transfer.
residualRisks.mitigation: Configure approved public endpoints and obtain signed expiring complete-transfer receipts from a genuinely outside observer for both fleet lanes.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Forty current outside-network receipts cover twenty artifacts across two independent lanes without project-hosted byte proxying.

residualRisks.summary: No authoritative catalog write contract or live announcement authority has admitted the model fleet.
residualRisks.mitigation: Use only the published catalog contract and authorized credentials after qualification and both current lane proofs exist.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Twenty current catalog announcement receipts survive unauthenticated HTTPS readback against one common catalog and feed snapshot.

residualRisks.summary: Linux ARM64 has emulated execution evidence but no execution receipt from physical ARM64 hardware.
residualRisks.mitigation: Run the approved package, native ABI, fleet lifecycle, and cleanup verification on authorized physical Linux ARM64 hardware.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: The current native RID receipt records physical Linux ARM64 execution and all three native RID gates pass.

residualRisks.summary: Packaged local-site verification cannot prove deployed public bytes, catalog rows, or announcement feed bytes.
residualRisks.mitigation: After authorized deployment, fetch every declared public artifact and common catalog snapshot over HTTPS and compare exact release hashes.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: The current deployment receipt proves all required HTTPS hashes and authoritative catalog readback.

residualRisks.summary: Seventeen locally executable fault cases pass, while seven cases still require physical-host, live-service, outside-network, or deployment evidence.
residualRisks.mitigation: Execute each remaining case only in its declared evidence domain and preserve separate domain and attempt receipts.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: All twenty-four fault attempts and their authoritative domain receipts satisfy the canonical fault plan.

residualRisks.summary: The campaign lacks a verified authorized release signature or equivalent attestation over a complete final predicate.
residualRisks.mitigation: Generate the content-addressed predicate from validated evidence, obtain an authorized signature verification receipt, and regenerate the final envelope after all other gates pass.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: Dashboard v8 validates a deployment-class final-attestation receipt bound to an authorized verified signature and the complete campaign predicate.

residualRisks.summary: The installed NVIDIA device is lost and broad comparative training cannot currently use GPU acceleration.
residualRisks.mitigation: Recover the device through an authorized host restart or use separately authorized GPU capacity after source and data gates pass.
residualRisks.acceptanceCondition: An approved training environment passes device, mixed-precision, checkpoint-recovery, and throughput preflight.
